blocker_queue_claim_boundary: Formal acceptance blocker queue only. Rows are work items for reviewers; they do not create approvals, source evidence, calibrated validation, or operational routing permission.
claim_boundary: Sub-agent task assignments only. These rows assign review work; they do not approve evidence, certify licenses, validate calibration, or close final-study gates.
orchestration_claim_boundary: Sub-agent records are review aids. They do not replace formal acceptance artifacts, source-backed reviewer decisions, calibrated validation, or operational routing approval.
review_items: each task requires source-backed evidence or an explicit blocked decision
review packets and templates are aids only, not formal acceptance
rerun scripts/run_acceptance_audit.py after any formal artifact changes
